126
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, December 8, 2010/Agrahayana 17, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Road Transport and Highways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Bilateral trade relations with Israel
*401. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Free Trade
Agreement (FTA) with Israel that was
discussed earlier this year;
(b) whether there are any benefits to
India with this agreement;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether bilateral trade relations
between India and Israel have increased
thereafter?
Migration from Leh-Ladakh villages
adjoining Pakistan and China
†*402. SHRI MUKHTAR ABBAS
NAQVI: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
people of many villages of Leh, like
Nobara, Turtuk, Partapur, Thang, Tuksi
etc., adjoining the border with Pakistan and
China are migrating in large scale because
of lack of basic facilities, education and
employment  turning the area devoid of
human habitation; and
(b) the measures including special
schemes/programmes for development,
being taken by Government for
development and security of areas of Leh-
Ladakh adjoining Pakistan border and
villages adjoining China border?
Encroachment of defence land in UP
†*403. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether defence land in Gorakhpur,
Lucknow, Kanpur and Varanasi districts of
Uttar Pradesh has been encroached upon
by land mafia on the lines of Adarsh Society
of Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is aware that
hundreds of  acres of land in trans-Gomti
rifle range and Amausi of Lucknow is under
illegal occupation of land mafia; and
(d) if so, the action taken by the
Ministry so far against illegal occupants of
defence land as well as to remove
encroachers therefrom?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

127
Modernisation of CPMFs
*404. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
KASHYAP: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Para-Military
Forces (CPMFs) are not being provided
with modern weapons and communication
and other equipments;
(b) if so, the details thereof and action
taken by Government in this regard; and
(c) the total funds allocated, released
and utilized for modernisation of CPMFs
during each of the last three years and till
date, force-wise?
Programmes and training etc.
undertaken by NDMA
*405. SHRIMATI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the programmes, trainings, etc.
undertaken by the National Disaster
Management Authority (NDMA) during
the last three years, year-wise and State-
wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that National
Cyclone Risk Mitigation Project has been
undertaken with the help of World Bank
for Andhra Pradesh;
(c) if so, the  details of programmes
undertaken under the above Project in
Andhra Pradesh; and
(d) the details of training given to
Disaster Response Force to deal with
cyclone, floods, etc., in Andhra Pradesh?
Cost escalation in deal of Admiral
Gorshkov
†*406. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether part of the payment
reflected in documents and phenomenal
increase in the stipulated cost of 2004
agreement for combat aircraft carrier
Admiral Gorshkov is suspected to be
forged;
(b) whether it has been ensured that the
other party would not increase the
stipulated amount while delivering the
carrier to India is 2012, as happened in
case of 2004 agreement; and
(c) the truth behind the questions
cropped up in the wake of forged payment
of escalated costs?
Compulsory registration of birth,
death and marriage
†*407. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether registration of birth, death
and marriage has been made compulsory
by Government;
(b) if so, details of the agency which
carries out this work at State, district,
development block and village level;
(c) the national average for registration
of birth, death and marriage and whether
the said registrations are  being carried out
as per the estimates of national average;
and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor and the
measures being taken by Government to
ensure that these registrations are brought
to national average?
Proposals sent by Chhattisgarh for
inclusion under NHs network
†*408. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the roads along with their length in
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

128
kilometres for which Chhattisgarh has sent
proposals to include them under the
National Highways network;
(b) the proposals along with the length
of the roads out of the said roads approved
by the Central Government;
(c) whether certain proposals have been
kept pending for different reasons;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) whether the remaining proposals are
likely to be approved by the Central
Government after changes are introduced
in the proposals?
Awarding operation and maintenance
contracts for toll plazas
*409. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of National
Highways Authority of India (NHAI) toll
plazas in the country;
(b) whether NHAI has a plan to award
operation and maintenance contracts for
94 toll plazas across the country;
(c) if so, the State-wise location of the
94 toll plazas;
(d) whether it is a fact that Road Safety
Forum has demanded 'better-distancing and
merging' of some toll plazas to provide
better service to people; and
(e) what steps will be taken by NHAI
to review the location, frequency and
rationalization of toll plazas on National
Highway-5 and other highways
immediately?
Fulfilment of promises made after
visit of all party delegation to J&K
*410. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the current status of
fulfilment of promises made after the visit
of all party delegation to J & K with a view
to finding out solutions to the ongoing
problems in the State; and
(b) what is the response of the general
public thereto?
Formation of National Employment
Labour Policy
*411. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: W ill the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has formulated
the National Employment Labour Policy
in the recent past;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether factors such as job security,
better remuneration, new opportunity for
investment and employment retention etc.
form some of the major components of the
said Policy; and
(d) if so,  the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Delhi Traffic Police
*412. SHRI PARVEZ HASHMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Delhi Traffic Police is
mandated to regulate the traffic or to challan
the violators of traffic rules;
(b) the reasons why towing charges are
more than the challan amount fined by the
Hon'ble Court and the manual;
(c) who are the owners of cranes, the
criteria to engage these cranes and the
payment to them; and
(d) why towing charges are not
mentioned in the challan receipt?

129
Court of Enquiry report on sexual
harassment by Army General
*413. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Court of
Enquiry into the allegation of sexual
harassment of the wife of colonel against
the senior Army General has submitted its
report and if so, the details thereof;
(b) the details of the action taken on the
report;
(c) whether it is also a fact that similar
allegation of sexual harassment by the same
officer and his wife were levelled in the
past which were found to be false; and
(d) if so, what action Government
proposes to take against such officers who
make unsubstantiated allegations against
their officers?
Creating more jobs in rural and
urban areas
*414. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
unemployment rate is high at 11.1 per cent
in rural areas and 7.3 per cent in urban areas
as the Labour Bureau Report suggests;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Ministry has taken any
steps to create more jobs, both in rural and
urban areas;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Proposal for giving land of NTC to
MHADA
†*415. SHRI Y . P. TRIVEDI: Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of
Maharashtra has submitted a proposal to
Central Government to withhold the tender
procedure in respect of the land measuring
an area of 3393.38 sq. feet belonging to
National Textiles Corporation (NTC) Mill,
involving ` 750 crore, and make the same
available to the Maharashtra Housing and
Area Development Authority (MHADA)
for constructing houses for economically
weaker and under-privileged sections of the
society;
(b) if so, the date of submission of the
said proposal along with its present status;
(c) whether Government has since
approved the proposal; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Construction and maintenance of
NHs in U.P.
*416. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of expenditure incurred
on construction and maintenance of
National Highways in Uttar Pradesh during
the last year and current year;
(b) the details of National Highways in
Uttar Pradesh whose maintenance and
upkeep is not upto the mark as on date;
(c) the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps being taken in the matter?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

130
Setting up an International Diamond
Trading Centre
†*417. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has set up/
propose to set up an International Diamond
Trading Centre in the country;
(b) whether it is a fact that India has
been the largest buyer of raw diamonds in
the world;
(c) if so,  the details  thereof;
(d) whether Government proposes to
allow/has allowed Foreign Direct
Investment in exploration/testing of
diamonds; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Glorification of Kashmiri secessionists
at a conference in Delhi
†*418. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a conference was held in
Delhi in October, 2010 wherein Kashmiri
secessionists were glorified;
(b) whether a view that Kashmir has
never been an integral part of India, was
expressed therein;
(c) whether representatives of Naxalites
were also present therein;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the speech challenging
Indian Union's unity, integrity and
sovereignty was opposed at that place and
afterwards in the whole country; and
(f) if so, action taken by Government in
this regard, till now?
Digitization of defence lands
*419. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ownership/
possession of large tract of lands across
the country rest with the Indian Defence
Estate Establishments;
(b) whether each of them are
appropriately recorded/digitised and any
encroachment thereon is detected
promptly;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the piece
of land at Colaba in Mumbai where a
residential flats project was constructed
over a period exceeding last ten years, had
been owned by/in possession of the Defence
Establishment but was alienated in favour
of Adarsh Housing Society; and
(d) if so, details of the said land alienation
in chronological order indicating rationale
thereof?
Transportation of camels in cruel
manner by BSF
*420. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Border Security Force
(B.S.F.) has recently shifted its camels from
Rajasthan to Delhi in a very cruel manner
(with their feet tied) for Republic Day
celebrations;
(b) if so, the reasons for transporting
them in such a cruel manner; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
ensure transportation of camels as per
standard norms?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 2nd December, 2010 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 11, 1932 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Commerce and Industry : 401, 417,
Defence : 402, 403, 406, 413, 419,
Home Affairs : 404, 405, 407, 410, 412, 418, 420,
Labour and Employment : 411, 414,
Road Transport and Highways : 408, 409, 416,
Textiles : 415.
GMGIPMRND—5622RS(S-3)—02.12.2010.
